name: 6 Pro

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 10 with realme UI 1, Current: Android 11 with realme UI 2
Platform.CPU: Qualcomm Snapdragon 720G (8 nm), octa-core (2×2.3 GHz Kryo 465 Gold & 6×1.8 GHz Kryo 465 Silver)

Cameras.Rear camera: 64 MP, f/1.8, 26 mm (wide), 1/1.72", 0.8 µm, PDAF + 12 MP, f/2.5, 54 mm (telephoto), 1/3.4", 1.0 µm, PDAF, 2x optical zoom + 8 MP, f/2.3, 13 mm (ultrawide), 1/4.0", 1.12 µm + 2 MP, f/2.4 (macro), LED flash, HDR, panorama, Video: 4K@30fps, 1080p@30/60/120fps, gyro-EIS
